description:
A desktop terminal for running multiple CLI agents in parallel sessions.

PATerminal provides parallel terminal sessions, split panes, session resume,
agent status, and Git tools for CLI agent workflows on Windows and macOS.
CLI agents must be installed and authenticated separately.
Official builds include a 30-day trial of all features. Advanced features
require a license after the trial. The source is available under a proprietary license.
Changes
- Worktree moved into each pane's Git controls. The Worktree button is no longer in the top toolbar. It is now in the Git section of every pane's top bar (and in the branch list popover), and it creates a worktree for that pane's repository without opening the Git window.
- Commit button in the pane bar. Opens the Git window's file status with the commit message ready to type. It is disabled when there are no changes.
- Worktrees outside the repository are grouped by repository. New worktrees go to <location>/<repository name>/<branch> (for example ~/worktrees/myapp/feature-x). This applies to the Worktree dialog, PRs and Issue runs. A location that already ends with the repository name is not doubled. Existing worktrees are not moved.
macOS Universal and Windows x64 installers are attached by the release workflow. This release becomes Latest after the build and updater signature checks succeed.
